title: Units Ledger Standard: Prior Grants and Prior Authorization Extension Units
content:
The units a Prairie Ridge Prior Authorization extension adds are cut according to the units already granted on the authorization.

## Standard

The units already granted are all the units posted to the authorization as granted before the extension is recorded, whatever the reason for the grant: the initial approval, a transition-of-care grant and any earlier extension.

| Units already granted on the authorization | Units taken off |
|---|---|
| 12 or more | 2 |
| 6 to 11 | 1 |
| fewer than 6 | 0 |

The cut is taken once from the units the extension adds, before the floor of zero and the ceiling of the class's extension allotment are applied.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- An initial grant of 12 units: 12 or more, 2 units taken off.
- An initial grant of 8 units and an earlier extension of 4 units: 12 in total, 2 units taken off.
- 11 units granted: 1 unit taken off; 6 units granted: 1 unit taken off.
- 5 units granted: nothing taken off.
